messages:
maria: Heads-up — eu-west-2 warm pool seeing a sustained p95 increase (~30%) and a bunch of kernel drop counters on gpu-rack-12 around 09:14 UTC. Suspect a tenant batch job is hogging egress and pushing NIC queues into slowpath.

kenji: Got the alert. Any tenant id / pod id?

maria: tenant=acme-vision, pod=vision-batch-7721. Logs from node show repeated TC drop and NVLINK RT contention. snippet: 
```
May 03 09:14:25 gpu-rack-12 kernel: net_rx: dropped=12456 dev=eth0 qdisc=pfifo_fast backlog=1024
May 03 09:14:27 nvlink: peer 0x3 busy for 220ms
```

lia: ugh. acme-vision has been ramping large batched embeddings. We can soft-fence: apply egress shaping + move new allocs off that rack. Quick `tc` to test: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 800mbit burst 32kb latency 50ms` — that'll shed tails without evicting containers.

samir: Shaping is fine short-term, but this tenant is in a shared warm pool. If we move to a dedicated slice we pay reserved capacity cost. Cost rough calc: their 2x nightly batches => ~700 GPU-hours/mo; dedicated would be ~30% more than preemptible routing costs. Isolated aversion vs SLA?

maria: For now let's soft-fence plus routing-weight tweak. I can push a denylist for new warm-allocs on rack-12 and set alloc-weight for acme-vision to 0.3. That should lower pressure while we debug model crop.

kenji: Doing it now — applying denylist and tc on node gpu-rack-12. Watchdogs alerting if we backpressure too hard.

ops-bot: [ALERT] EGRESS_SPIKE eu-west-2 gpu-rack-12 tenant=acme-vision p95_latency=820ms drop_rate=1.8% action=investigate

lia: Also adding a temporary route rule: prefer eu-west-2b for their large batches (less saturated AZ). Might need to pin their warm pool to avoid churn.

samir: Agree. Long-term we should add a cost-meter for 'noisy warm tenants' and a one-click carveout from console that creates a fractional dedicated slice for X hours. Otherwise recurring migrations are ops-heavy.

maria: Notes for postmortem: steps taken, tc command, denylist id=deny-1777, routing-weight change from 1.0 -> 0.3, temporary AZ pin to eu-west-2b. Will collect nvlink + qdisc counters and tenant request-profile for the last 48h.

kenji: Outcome: shaping reduced drop_rate to 0.2% within 2m. Keeping soft-fence for 4 hours and will escalate if we see >0.5% again.

lia: Leaving runbook tasks: 1) gather KV cache regen pattern (could be frags causing nvlink bursts) 2) assess cost vs dedicated for acme-vision 3) automate soft-fence button on console.

samir: tagging @lia for automation, @maria for data, @kenji to follow up on kernel traces. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will paste traces and a short RCA draft in this thread in 2h.
